title: 第十九回 冰晶封印第二十回 如意冰晶
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 第十九回冰晶封印
“哎哎，可怜的人~哎！”
“生~的这~么俏美，怎……么一个人跑到这……里~哭？”
三角眼、猪鬃眉、下巴一颗毛痣，容月只看此人一眼，便觉得恶心想吐，更别说这人舌头拧巴，说话流里流气的了。
容月四下看看，发现自己一时不知道跑到了哪里，四下无人，此处不宜久留，于是她当机立断，转身便跑。
“哎——哎，别……跑耶，我们还没认~识呐。”
谁料想，那个人驱马上前一步，堵住容月的去路，容月这下慌了神，她万万没有想到，刚出地府，就遇见一个歹人。
容月于是便掉头往另外一边跑，谁料，那个人竟策马在后边追。
容月心生恐惧，她回头大喊：“你想干什么，我不认识你。”
“哎~呀，小~可怜，我看你一~个人哭，心里~不……落忍，爷~想~陪……陪你。”
“我不需要你陪，你走开，我不认识你。”
“没~关系，刚开始谁~也~不认~识~谁，接~触一……下，就好了。”
那人说着，嬉笑着，弯身就是一抱，欲把容月揽上马。
容月闪身避开，慌忙之下，她从地上捡起一根树枝，双手握在手中，握剑一般冲那人道：“你赶紧走开，再不走，我就喊啦。”
马上那公子见状，哈哈不禁大笑：“好啊，你~喊……吧，我的人就……在后面呐。”
“你把~他们都……喊过来吧，哈哈哈。”
两个人正对话间，就见后面过来一队人马，马上一个道士，还有几个兵，个个耀武扬威，趾高气扬，不可一世状。
道士策马过来道：“大少爷，你这马跑的也太快了，你也等等小的们啊。”
“哎，这姑娘谁家的啊，看着挺zhun啊。”
“我也不~知道，刚才我看她一~个人在那儿~哭，就想陪~陪她，结果，她还~不让！”
“为什么不让啊？”
一个兵士头目闻听说：“我家大少爷那是龙子凤孙，谁见了都想攀个高枝儿。”
“你可别太矫情啊。”
“我不认识你们，你们快走，要不然，我就喊了。”
容月大声道。
“哈哈哈……哈哈哈……”
几个人闻听，一起哈哈大笑。
那长相龌龊的公子手抬马鞭，手指容月道：“听见没~，她说她要喊，我正琢~磨，是带她回……去喊~呢，还是让她在……这~儿喊。”
“哈哈哈……哈哈哈……”
几个随从闻听，又爆发一阵各怀鬼胎的笑。
那公子冲几个手下挥挥马鞭，立即有两个手下领会，下马一起围拢过来，要捉容月，容月情急之下放声呼喊：“鹤雁！
鹤雁！
快来救我！”
孤鹤雁追出来晚了一步，他不知道容月跑向哪个方向，寻错了地方，待他净心听到容月的笛声，再循声过来时，容月已经被那些人捉放到了马上。
孤鹤雁见状厉喝一声：“住手！”
“快把人给我放了！”
“你们什么人？敢光天化日强抢民女！”
“嘿，这小哥哪来的？”
马上兵士头目闻听，话音中颇多讶异：“说话声，很硬啊！”
“哈哈哈，哈哈哈。”
几个人闻听一起放声大笑。
那长相龌龊的公子见突然来了一个大个少年，一身凛然，毫不畏惧他们人多势众，“嘿嘿”
两声冷笑：“嘿嘿，爷儿今天出来，算是对~了。”
“竟~然……遇到一~个愣头……青！”
“不见棺~材，不知道棺~材板~厚。”
content_en:
Chapter 19 Ice Crystal Seal
"Hey, poor guy~hey!"
"She's so pretty and beautiful, how come... she comes here... alone and cries?"
With triangular eyes, bristle eyebrows, and a hairy mole on his chin, Rong Yue felt sick just by looking at this person, not to mention that this person had a twisted tongue and a sloppy speech.
Rong Yue looked around and found that she didn't know where she had run. There was no one around and it was not suitable to stay here for a long time, so she made a quick decision, turned around and ran away.
"Hey - hey, don't... run away, we haven't gotten to know each other yet."
Unexpectedly, the man took a step forward on horseback and blocked Rong Yue's way. Rong Yue was now panicked. She never expected that she would meet a villain as soon as she left the underworld.
Rong Yue then turned around and ran to the other side. Unexpectedly, the man was chasing after her on horseback.
Rong Yue was frightened. She turned around and shouted, "What do you want to do? I don't know you."
"Oh, my dear, you're so pitiful. I see you crying alone, and I don't want to... let you down. I want to be with you... to be with you."
"I don't need your company, just go away, I don't know you."
"It doesn't matter. I don't know anyone at the beginning. Just make contact and it will be fine."
The man said, smiling playfully, and bent down to give Rong Yue a hug, trying to put Rong Yue on the horse.
Rong Yue dodged to avoid it. In a hurry, she picked up a branch from the ground, held it in her hands, and said to the man like she was holding a sword: "Go away quickly. If you don't go away, I will yell."
Immediately when the young man saw this, he couldn't help but laugh: "Okay, you~ shout..., my people are... behind."
"Call~ them all... over here, hahaha."
While the two people were having a conversation, they saw a group of people coming from behind, including a Taoist priest and several soldiers, all showing off their power, arrogance and arrogance.
The Taoist priest rode his horse over and said, "Young master, your horse is running too fast. You should wait for the younger ones."
"Hey, who does this girl belong to? She looks quite decent."
"I don't know either. Just now I saw her crying alone, and I wanted to stay with her, but she refused!"
"Why don't you let me?"
A soldier leader heard about it and said: "My eldest young master is the son of a dragon and a phoenix. Everyone who sees him wants to climb a high tree."
"Don't be too pretentious."
"I don't know you, please leave quickly, otherwise, I will shout."
Rong Yue said loudly.
"Hahaha...hahaha..."
Several people heard it and laughed together.
The dirty-looking young man raised his horsewhip and pointed his finger at Rong Yue and said, "Did you hear that? She said she wanted to shout. I'm thinking about whether to take her back to shout, or let her shout here."
"Hahaha...hahaha..."
When several followers heard this, they burst into laughter with their own ulterior motives.
The young master waved his riding whip at several of his men, and two of his men immediately understood, dismounted and gathered around to catch Rong Yue. In desperation, Rong Yue shouted loudly: "He Yan!
Crane geese!
Come and save me! "
Gu Heyan was a step too late to catch up. He didn't know which direction Rong Yue was running to and was looking for the wrong place. When he heard the sound of Rong Yue's flute and followed the sound, Rong Yue had already been captured and put on a horse by those people.
Gu Heyan saw this and shouted: "Stop!"
"Let me go quickly!"
"Who are you? You dare to rob a girl in broad daylight!"
"Hey, where did this guy come from?"
Immediately the soldier leader heard this and was quite surprised: "The voice is very strong!"
"Hahaha, hahaha."
Several people laughed loudly when they heard it.
The dirty-looking young man suddenly saw a big young man coming. He was dressed in a dignified manner and was not afraid of their numbers. He said, "Hey!"
Two sneers: "Hey, I'm right to come out today~"
"Unexpectedly... I met a dumbass... Qing!"
"I can't see the coffin material, and I don't know how thick the coffin material is."
